_comment: Host this JSON somewhere reachable (a web server, GitHub Pages, an S3 bucket) and put its URL in MesaShield Settings > Update source. Or skip this file entirely and use a GitHub 'owner/repo' as the update source, in which case MesaShield reads your GitHub Releases directly. When you publish a new build, bump 'version', upload the package, and set 'downloadUrl' + 'sha256'.
notes: AMSI scanning, ransomware guard, cloud reputation, tray, scheduling, auto-update.
